changelog.summary: Schema 2: 54 tags in 10 groups (21 new), polarity and limitations per tag, governance, the lifecycle exclusive group, recurring, days-since and balance metrics, and the counterparty and merchant code tables. Replaces 0.1.0.

description: Behaviour-based customer tags for the customer-tagging plugin. Each tag is a declarative rule over transaction and balance behaviour with explicit thresholds and time windows, a reason shown to staff, its known limitations and its polarity for fairness testing. Thresholds are illustrative starting points; bank policy sets the final values.

settings.notes: Fixed illustrative rates for the synthetic data, not market rates. A deployment supplies the bank's own rate table. Amount thresholds are in the base currency. history_months is how many months of transactions the profile keeps; it must cover the longest rule window. lifecycle_months is how many month-end checkpoints of tag history are kept.

fairness.age: Excluded by default. No tag uses age or date of birth. Adding one needs a tag explicitly marked 'bank policy decides' and an engine change; until then the engine refuses age fields.
proxies_avoided: health and medical spending (a proxy for disability and health)
charity and worship payments (a proxy for religion)
childcare and school fees (a proxy for family and marital status)
pension and benefit income by type (a proxy for age, disability, family status or pregnancy)
a specific country or currency, including a remittance's country or corridor (a proxy for national origin)
customer names, and the names of people a customer pays (a proxy for gender and ethnicity)
fairness.notes: The engine enforces these rules in code (engine/policy.py): restricted categories are collapsed into one opaque category when a transaction is read, person counterparties are pseudonymised, and no rule may select a specific country or currency. Editing this file cannot switch them off. Every tag shows its rule and the evidence that produced it; there are no scores.

governance.owner: The bank's taxonomy owner (to be named by the bank)
governance.intended_use: Service and personalisation by a relationship manager: understanding a customer's behaviour to offer relevant help and products. Tags inform a person; they never act on their own.
prohibited_uses: credit decisions of any kind, including limits and affordability
fraud, AML or other financial-crime decisions
any automated decision with legal or similarly significant effect on the customer
collections, or targeting sales at customers flagged by financial-stress signals
governance.notes: Every tag card repeats these uses. A change that would feed credit, pricing, insurance, fraud or AML decisions, add a score or learned model, add an automatic action, or use protected or proxy data changes the plugin's risk class and needs a fresh assessment before it is made.

groups.name: Income
groups.description: Where money comes from and how steady it is.

groups.name: Spending pattern
groups.description: What money is spent on and how that changes, never on restricted categories.

groups.name: Card use
groups.description: How and where cards are used.

groups.name: Channel and digital use
groups.description: Which channels the customer uses for self-service banking.

groups.name: Travel
groups.description: Spending abroad and travel bookings; never which country.

groups.name: Savings and balances
groups.description: Saving, investing and the balance kept on the account.

groups.name: Bills and subscriptions
groups.description: Regular bills, rent, loans, insurance and subscriptions.

groups.name: Transfers
groups.description: Money sent to and received from other people, at home or abroad.

groups.name: Engagement and lifecycle
groups.description: How new and how active the relationship is.

groups.name: Financial-stress signals
groups.description: Patterns that suggest a customer may welcome support. Worded for service, never for credit, pricing or collections.

exclusive_groups.description: One lifecycle stage per customer, checked in this order; the first that holds wins and the others are reported as suppressed.

tags.name: Salary earner
tags.description: Receives a salary credit every month.
tags.reason: salary credited monthly, {salary_months} of last 6 months, about {salary_avg} a month
limitations: Relies on the bank labelling salary credits; salary paid under another category is missed.
A salary paid every four weeks can skip a calendar month and miss the tag.

tags.name: Regular non-salary income
tags.description: Receives regular income other than salary from the same business payer.

all.description: regular income streams from one business payer, other than salary

tags.reason: regular income other than salary: {other_streams} steady stream(s) from the same payer in the last 6 complete months
limitations: Only business payers in the counterparty table count; income paid by a person is never treated as a stream.
Never says what the income is; pensions and benefits are restricted and never counted.

tags.name: Irregular income
tags.description: Earns income in most months, but the amount swings a lot from month to month and there is no steady salary.

all.description: months with earned income (salary or business income)
months where earned income was more than 40% above or below its usual (median) month
days since the account was opened

tags.reason: earned income arrived in {income_months} of last 12 months and was more than 40% above or below its usual month in {uneven_months} of last 12 months; no steady salary
limitations: Seasonal work that is steady year on year still looks irregular inside one year.

tags.name: Several income sources
tags.description: Received earned income from several different payers recently.
tags.reason: earned income from {payers} different payers in the last 90 days, {earned_90} in total
limitations: Counts distinct payers, so one client paying through two payer names counts twice.

tags.name: Business or freelance income
tags.description: Receives business or freelance income in most months.

all.description: months with business or freelance income

tags.reason: business or freelance income received in {business_months} of last 6 months
limitations: Depends on the bank's business-income category; informal income paid as transfers is missed.

tags.name: Remittance receiver
tags.description: Regularly receives money sent from abroad.

all.description: months with money received from abroad

tags.reason: money received from abroad in {remit_months} of last 6 months, {remit_total} in total
limitations: Uses only how often money arrives from abroad and how much, never the sending country; category labelling by the bank decides what counts.

tags.name: Rising income
tags.description: Average monthly earned income in the last 3 months is clearly above the 6 months before.

all.description: average monthly earned income, recent against earlier

tags.reason: average monthly earned income rose to {income_change} of its earlier level: {income_change.numerator} a month in the last 3 months against {income_change.denominator} in the 6 months before
limitations: A one-off bonus inside the last 3 months can lift the average.

tags.name: Falling income
tags.description: Average monthly earned income in the last 3 months is well below the 6 months before.

all.description: average monthly earned income, recent against earlier

tags.reason: average monthly earned income fell to {income_change} of its earlier level: {income_change.numerator} a month in the last 3 months against {income_change.denominator} in the 6 months before
limitations: Does not say why income fell and must never be read as a cause.

tags.name: Large recent inflow
tags.description: Received a single large credit recently, several times the usual monthly money in.

all.description: largest single credit against the usual monthly money in

tags.reason: a single credit of {largest} in the last 3 months, {inflow_ratio} the usual monthly money in of {inflow_ratio.denominator} in the 6 months before
limitations: A large credit may be a transfer between the customer's own accounts at another bank.

tags.name: High monthly inflow
tags.description: Money coming in averages a high amount per month.
tags.reason: money in averaged {avg_in} a month over the last 6 months
limitations: Money in includes transfers in, so moving money between banks can lift it.

tags.name: High cash user
tags.description: Takes out a large part of spending as cash.

all.description: share of spending taken as cash

tags.reason: cash withdrawals were {cash_share} of spending in the last 90 days, {cash_count} withdrawals
limitations: Cash taken out for someone else counts as the customer's own spending.

tags.name: Eats out often
tags.description: Pays at restaurants and cafés several times a month, most months.

all.description: months with at least 4 restaurant or café payments

facts.description: average spent on restaurants per month

tags.reason: eats out often: 4 or more restaurant payments in {dining_months} of the last 6 complete months
limitations: Depends on the merchant category; a café inside a shop may be labelled as shopping.

tags.name: Regular grocery shopper
tags.description: Buys groceries several times a month, nearly every month.

all.description: months with at least 4 grocery payments

tags.reason: regular grocery shopping: 4 or more grocery payments in {grocery_months} of the last 6 complete months
limitations: Groceries paid in cash are not seen.

tags.name: Regular commuter
tags.description: Pays for transport or fuel many times a month.

all.description: months with at least 6 transport or fuel payments

tags.reason: regular transport or fuel spending: 6 or more payments in {commute_months} of the last 6 complete months
limitations: A monthly travel pass bought once a month does not count as commuting.

tags.name: Recent large purchase
tags.description: Made a single card purchase recently that is large compared with usual card spending.

all.description: largest card purchase against usual monthly card spending

tags.reason: a recent large purchase of {largest_purchase}, {purchase_vs_usual} the usual monthly card spending of {purchase_vs_usual.denominator}
limitations: A purchase paid by transfer or in instalments is not seen as one large purchase.

tags.name: Spending rising
tags.description: Average monthly spending in the last 3 months is clearly above the 6 months before.

all.description: average monthly spending, recent against earlier

tags.reason: spending rose to {spend_change} of its earlier level: {spend_change.numerator} a month against {spend_change.denominator}
limitations: Seasonal spending, such as a holiday month, can lift the recent average.
Says nothing about affordability and must never be used for credit.

tags.name: Card-heavy spender
tags.description: Most spending is by card.

all.description: share of spending made by card

tags.reason: {card_share} of spending was by card in the last 90 days, {card_count} card payments
limitations: Card spending through a digital wallet may be labelled as another channel.

tags.name: Online shopper
tags.description: Makes frequent online card purchases.
tags.reason: {online_count} online card purchases in the last 90 days
limitations: Relies on the online channel flag from the card network.

tags.name: Foreign-currency spender
tags.description: A large part of card spending is in foreign currencies.

all.description: share of card spending in a foreign currency
card payments in a foreign currency

tags.reason: {fx_share} of card spending in the last 90 days was in foreign currencies, {fx_count} payments
limitations: Online purchases priced in a foreign currency count the same as spending abroad.

tags.name: Card no longer used
tags.description: Used a card regularly before, but not in the last 3 complete months.
tags.reason: card used {cards_before} times in the 9 months before, but not in the last 3 complete months
limitations: A replaced or reissued card is the same card here; a card at another bank is not seen.

tags.name: Digital-first
tags.description: Does almost all self-service banking in the app, online banking or with online card payments.

all.description: share of self-service transactions made digitally

tags.reason: {digital_share} of {self_count} self-service transactions in the last 90 days were in the app, online banking or online card payments
limitations: Counts transactions, not logins: someone who checks the app but pays in a branch is not digital-first.

tags.name: Branch-reliant
tags.description: Does much of their self-service banking in a branch.

all.description: share of self-service transactions made in a branch

tags.reason: {branch_share} of self-service transactions in the last 90 days were in a branch, {branch_count} branch transactions
limitations: Reflects the channel only; must never be read as a sign of age or ability.

tags.name: Regular cash depositor
tags.description: Deposits cash in most months.
tags.reason: cash deposited in {deposit_months} of last 6 months
limitations: Does not say where the cash comes from.

tags.name: Active in the mobile app
tags.description: Uses the mobile app every month and often.

all.description: months with a mobile app transaction

tags.reason: uses the mobile app every month: {app_txns} app transactions in the last 90 days
limitations: Counts transactions made in the app, not logins or balance checks.

tags.name: Frequent traveller
tags.description: Uses a card or ATM abroad in several different months.

all.description: months with card or ATM use abroad
different countries with card or ATM use

tags.reason: card or ATM used abroad in {abroad_months} of last 12 months, in {countries} countries
limitations: Online purchases from foreign merchants with a foreign merchant country can look like travel; never says which country.

tags.name: Travelled recently
tags.description: Used a card or ATM abroad in the last 30 days.
tags.reason: card or ATM used abroad {abroad_recent} times in the last 30 days
limitations: Never says which country.
Needs the home country; without it the tag is not evaluated.

tags.name: Books travel
tags.description: Pays for flights, hotels or travel agents in several months of the year.

all.description: months with a travel booking (airline, hotel, travel agent or car hire)

tags.reason: travel booked in {travel_months} of the last 12 complete months
limitations: Depends on merchant codes; travel booked through a general marketplace is missed.
Never says where the customer travels.

tags.name: Saver
tags.description: Regularly moves money to savings, or keeps a good part of what comes in.

any.description: months with a transfer to savings
months where at least 20% of money in was kept (interest not counted)

tags.reason: moved money to savings in {transfer_months} of last 6 months; kept 20% or more of money in during {surplus_months} of last 12 months
limitations: Savings held at another bank are not seen.

tags.name: Investor
tags.description: Buys investments.
tags.reason: {invest_count} investment purchases in the last 180 days
limitations: Investments made through another provider are not seen.

tags.name: Keeps a healthy buffer
tags.description: Keeps an average month-end balance of at least three months of spending, and never goes overdrawn.

all.description: average month-end balance against average monthly spending

tags.reason: keeps a buffer of {buffer_months} monthly spending ({buffer_months.numerator} against {buffer_months.denominator} a month), lowest balance {lowest_balance}
limitations: Needs the balance after each transaction; without it the tag is not evaluated.
Money kept in other accounts is not seen.

tags.name: Balance growing
tags.description: The average month-end balance of the last 3 months is well above the 6 months before.

all.description: average month-end balance, recent against earlier

tags.reason: month-end balance grew to {balance_change} of its earlier level: {balance_change.numerator} against {balance_change.denominator}
limitations: Needs the balance after each transaction; without it the tag is not evaluated.
A single large credit can lift the balance without any change in habits.

tags.name: Large balance, little activity
tags.description: Keeps a large balance but uses the account little; a savings conversation may help.
tags.reason: average month-end balance of {avg_balance} with only {recent_activity} self-service transactions in the last 90 days
limitations: Needs the balance after each transaction; without it the tag is not evaluated.
For service only: never for pricing or product steering against the customer's interest.

tags.name: Regular bill payer
tags.description: Pays utility or phone bills nearly every month.

all.description: months with a utility or phone bill payment

tags.reason: utility or phone bills paid in {bill_months} of last 6 months
limitations: Bills paid from another account or by someone else are not seen.

tags.name: Rent payer
tags.description: Pays rent nearly every month.
tags.reason: rent paid in {rent_months} of last 6 months
limitations: Rent paid as a plain transfer without the rent category is missed.

tags.name: Loan repayer
tags.description: Makes loan repayments nearly every month.
tags.reason: loan repayments made in {loan_months} of last 6 months
limitations: Shows only repayments made from this account; says nothing about creditworthiness and must never be used in a credit decision.

tags.name: Insurance payer
tags.description: Pays insurance premiums regularly (monthly or quarterly).

all.description: months with an insurance premium payment

tags.reason: insurance premiums paid in {insurance_months} of last 12 months
limitations: Annual premiums paid once a year fall below the threshold.

tags.name: Subscription user
tags.description: Pays several different subscriptions.
tags.reason: paying {subscriptions} different subscriptions in the last 90 days
limitations: Depends on the subscription category; a subscription charged under another category is missed.

tags.name: Several recurring bills
tags.description: Pays at least two bills that recur every month at a steady amount.
tags.reason: {bill_streams} recurring monthly bills in the last 6 complete months
limitations: Only payees listed as billers in the counterparty table count.

tags.name: Many subscriptions
tags.description: Pays four or more subscriptions that recur every month.
tags.reason: {sub_streams} recurring monthly subscriptions in the last 6 complete months
limitations: Annual subscriptions are not counted.
Depends on the counterparty table to recognise one merchant behind different descriptors.

tags.name: Remittance sender
tags.description: Regularly sends money abroad.
tags.reason: money sent abroad in {send_months} of last 6 months, {send_total} in total
limitations: Uses only how often money is sent abroad and how much, never the destination.

tags.name: Frequent person-to-person transfers
tags.description: Sends or receives many transfers to and from other people.
tags.reason: {p2p_count} person-to-person transfers in the last 90 days
limitations: Counts transfers in both directions, so a few large and many small transfers weigh the same.

tags.name: New customer
tags.description: Opened their account recently.

all.description: days since the account was opened

tags.reason: account opened {tenure} ago
limitations: Needs the account opening date; without it the tag is not evaluated.

tags.name: Active
tags.description: Uses the account for self-service banking every month.
tags.reason: self-service activity in {active_months} of the last 3 complete months
limitations: Interest, fees and incoming payments do not count as activity.

tags.name: Going dormant
tags.description: Self-service activity has dropped sharply compared with before.

all.description: self-service transactions per month, recent against earlier

tags.reason: self-service activity fell to {activity_change} of its earlier level: on average {activity_change.numerator} a month in the last 90 days against {activity_change.denominator} a month in the 270 days before
limitations: Activity moved to another account of the same customer looks like a drop.

tags.name: Dormant
tags.description: No self-service activity for six months.

all.description: days since the account was opened

tags.reason: no self-service transactions in the last 180 days; account open {tenure}
limitations: A service label only: it never replaces the bank's legal dormancy status and never changes the account.

tags.name: Re-engaged
tags.description: Became active again after a long quiet period.

all.description: days since the account was opened

tags.reason: {recent_count} self-service transactions in the last 90 days after {earlier_count} in the 180 days before
limitations: A single burst of activity can trigger it; the next month-end check shows whether it lasts.

tags.name: Established customer
tags.description: Has banked here for years and is active nearly every month.

all.description: days since the account was opened

tags.reason: account open {tenure}, active in {active_months} of last 12 months
limitations: Needs the account opening date; without it the tag is not evaluated.

tags.name: Salary credits stopped
tags.description: Received a salary nearly every month before, none in the last 2 months, but still uses the account.
tags.reason: salary credited in {salary_before} of the 6 months before, none in the last 2 complete months, while the account is still used
limitations: States only the pattern seen; it never says why the salary stopped.

tags.name: Spending exceeds money in
tags.description: Spent clearly more than came in during most recent months.

all.description: months where money out exceeded money in by 100 or more (base currency)

tags.reason: spent more than came in during {deficit_months} of last 6 months
limitations: Spending from savings held elsewhere looks like spending above income; a support signal, never for credit, pricing or collections.

tags.name: Frequent bank charges
tags.description: Pays bank charges often; a better-suited account might avoid them.
tags.reason: {fee_count} bank charges in the last 90 days, {fee_total} in total
limitations: Counts charges, not their cause.
A support signal only: never for credit, pricing or collections.

tags.name: Repeatedly low balance
tags.description: The balance fell below 100 in several recent months.

all.description: months where the lowest balance was below 100 (base currency)

tags.reason: balance fell below 100 in {low_months} of the last 6 complete months
limitations: A support signal only: never for credit, pricing or collections.
Needs the balance after each transaction; without it the tag is not evaluated.

tags.name: Overdrawn in several months
tags.description: The balance went below zero in at least two recent months.

all.description: months where the balance went below zero

tags.reason: balance went below zero in {overdrawn_months} of the last 6 complete months
limitations: A support signal only: never for credit, pricing or collections.
Needs the balance after each transaction; without it the tag is not evaluated.

tags.name: Returned payments
tags.description: Had payments returned unpaid more than once recently.
tags.reason: {returned} payments returned unpaid in the last 180 days
limitations: A support signal only: never for credit, pricing or collections.
Depends on the bank labelling returned payments.

tags.name: Income gap
tags.description: Earned income arrived nearly every month before, but not in the last 2 months.

all.description: months with earned income (salary or business income)

tags.reason: earned income in {earned_before} of the 6 months before, none in the last 2 complete months
limitations: States only the pattern seen; it never says why income stopped.
A support signal only: never for credit, pricing or collections.
